subject.name: Rehabilitation counselors
subject.summary: Rehabilitation counselors assess the personal, social, and vocational difficulties caused by disability or illness, develop rehabilitation plans with clients to support independent living and employment, coordinate assessments, training, assistive equipment, referrals, and job placement, and track progress. Specific counseling, diagnostic, and service qualifications depend on the jurisdiction and institutional authorization.
